caption: The drawing features a single ornamental object positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The object consists of a long, vertical pin or needle at the top, rendered in a metallic tone. Attached to the lower part of the pin is an intricate design composed of a large, rounded central element, resembling a pearl or white gemstone, encased in delicate gold-colored metalwork. From the central element, a fine gold chain extends, branching downward and supporting three smaller, similarly encased rounded ornaments, each resembling smaller pearls or beads with gold floral motifs. Two of these smaller ornaments are attached along one chain that descends straight down, while another chain loops to the left, holding an additional ornament. Each rounded element is capped and decorated with detailed, ornate gold filigree, and tiny bead-like pendants hang from the bottom of the smallest spheres. The entire composition uses predominantly soft gold, white, and off-white tones, with the gold elements providing detailed patterns and connections between the rounded ornaments.
title: Hair Ornament
